name: Pre-integration of Transfer Function Contribution
aliases: Pre-integrated Transfer Function Tables (Engel et al.)
definition: A technique proposed by Engel et al. to smooth image imperfections caused by low sampling frequencies. It addresses the dichotomy between image quality and performance in volume rendering by pre-integrating the transfer function's contribution along ray segments.
summary: Pre-integration of Transfer Function Contribution replaces on-the-fly integration with pre-computed lookup tables, decoupling transfer function integration from sampling to smooth image imperfections.
